content:
Elena M: Quick preflight for the webinar landing  need a tight SEO checklist: keywords, JSON-LD, internal link touches, and redirects. Target go-live next Wed.

Ravi K: Propose 3 primaries + a few longtails. Also need title + meta desc variants.

Elena M: Primaries: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "inference cost optimization". Longtails: KV cache, continuous batching, quantization profiles.

Tara L: I'll add minimal JSON-LD (Event + FAQ). Snippet for head: ```<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Serving LLMs in Prod","startDate":"2024-07-10T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/serving-llms"}</script>```

Devon P: Redirect CSV I'll run the night after publish. Sample:
```
source,target,code
/old-webinar,/events/serving-llms,301
/blog/2023/llm-inference,/events/serving-llms,301
```

Ravi K: Internal link work: PRs to add CTAs from /docs/runtime, /product/features, /resources. Anchors: "low-latency serving", "dedicated capacity", "reduce inference cost". I'll open PRs.

Elena M: Inbound routing notes: include utm params + webinar_id in CRM webhook. Rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR queue; else -> nurture. Add field "interested_in" for SKU. @Devon please confirm payload keys.

Devon P: Confirmed. Webhook payload will include: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. Returns 200 OK on success.

Elena M: Timeline: draft by Fri, landing Wed, redirect sweep Wed night. Owners: Tara (schema & copy), Devon (redirects & webhooks), Ravi (internal links), Elena (PM).

SEO-bot: Created MARKETING-9001 "webinar landing SEO + redirects" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-9001)

Elena M: I'll paste the draft here when ready. Any blockers?

Ravi K: None from Eng. :thumbsup:
